description: Shared types for the contributions.fyi dataset. All amounts are whole US dollars, rounded to the nearest dollar (the atproto data model has no floating-point numbers); the JSON files referenced from fyi.contributions.dataset keep exact cents.

sector.description: One of a fixed set of sectors, roughly OpenSecrets' sectors. Individual donations also use 'Retired' and 'Not employed'.

amount.description: Money attributed to an entity. What 'id' refers to depends on the field: a bioguide id (fyi.contributions.member), FEC committee id (fyi.contributions.committee), organization id (fyi.contributions.organization), donor id (fyi.contributions.donor) or a sector name.

cycleAmount.description: Money in one two-year election cycle, named for the year it ends (2024 = 2023-2024).

outside.description: Independent expenditures: money spent for or against a candidate without coordinating with the campaign.

outsideAmount.description: Independent expenditures involving one other entity: a spender (FEC committee id) on a member's record, or a target (bioguide id) on a committee's record.
